messages:
Ana (partnerships): Quick check — running a tier sweep for partner program ahead of next week's QBR. Need to lock MDF cadence + scorecard redlines. Who's on deck to review marketplace credits and SI co-sell TPAs?
James R: I can take marketplace credits. Will update the ledger and send POV by EOD. Link to current sheet: https://docs.google.com/some_dummy_link
Marco - GTM: I'll handle SI integrations runway — need dev timelines from eng-ml. Can we get commit by Thu?
Sasha: Scorecard ask — propose we move from ARR-led metric to 'enabled deals' for tiering. Short rationale: aligns with co-sell activity. Thoughts?
Debs: MDF question — are we keeping 3-tier split (Startup/Scale/Enterprise) or adding 'Marketplace-first' bucket? Legal wants clearer use-cases in application form.
Lee: :eyes: FYI cloud marketplace has a promo pool of $120k credits; could seed Marketplace-first bucket if we want.
partners-bot: Reminder: QBR deck draft due in 3 days. Upload to /shared/partners/qbr/
Ana (partnerships): Thanks. Action items: (1) James update credits table (2) Marco confirm SI milestones + eng contact (3) Sasha formalize scorecard language (4) Debs propose MDF eligibility wording. Can everyone ack?
James R: :thumbsup: I got (1). I'll add a new column `promo_pool_source`.
Marco - GTM: Ack. Ping @olivia-eng for commit. If eng can't hit Thu, we push SI go/no-go to the Feb QBR.
Sasha: I'll post a short PR with the scorecard text and sample queries. Quick metric draft:
```
- enabled_deals (count): deals with co-sell activity + partner-sourced pipeline
- marketplace_leads (count)
- partner_response_time (median hours)
```
Any missing?
Debs: Add 'MDF spend-to-influence' % — want to see efficiency across tiers.
Lee: Would we cap Marketplace-first bucket at $30k per partner? Also need to confirm cloud promo expiration (31 Mar).
Ana (partnerships): Perfect. I'll collate into a single slide. One policy question: do we allow retroactive MDF for closed-won deals within 30 days? previous doc left ambiguous.
James R: Retroactive ok up to 14 days, anything longer needs ops approval. Let's set 14.
Sasha: Agreed.
Debs: Legal flagged retroactive programs as audit risk; 14 days okay but require invoice + deal link.
Ana (partnerships): Noted. I'll draft an ops playbook snippet:
```
- Retroactive MDF: 14d max, require invoice + SFDC deal id, ops approval
- Marketplace-first: cap $30k, proof-of-listing + 3x expected demo conversions
- Tier promotion: 90d review window, 2 validated enabled deals min
```
Send any redlines today.
Marco - GTM: Putting eng ask in #eng-ml now. cc @olivia-eng
Olivia-eng: On it, will confirm GPU infra timeline by Wed.
Lee: :calendar: Can we set a 30min sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize slides? Quick huddle.
Ana (partnerships): 10am PT works. I'll book invite and attach sheet. Thanks all :pray:
